description: Nintendo 3DS system titles merged from the 3dbrew Title list and Azahar src/core/system_titles.cpp. Names, title IDs, regions, and published version numbers only.
notes: 3dbrew version arrays are the title versions listed on the wiki, not every CDN build.
Azahar region order is JPN, USA, EUR, AUS, CHN, KOR, TWN. A zero title-id low in the source means that region has no title and is omitted.
Titles present in only one source are kept. The names object keeps each source's original name.
TWL system title ID lows such as 42383841 are the eight hex digits from the wiki. Those digits are also ASCII.
Download Play child titles (00040001) and DSiWare ports (00048004) are not included.
